rationale: The agent correctly bumped the version and fixed the main compilation errors by replacing child/children calls with childElement/childElements. However, the verifier test run reveals 4 test failures (GAVUtilsTest, InferenceStrategyTest) caused by missing API adaptations: the agent did not update AbstractUpgradeStrategy.computeAllArtifactCoordinates to deduplicate by GAV using a HashMap, and did not replace removeNode with removeChild in ModelVersionUtils. These omissions are concrete and directly cause the test failures.
